questions.question: A ‘mixed drink’ is …
options: a mix of spirit and additive such as an aerated water
a mix of beer and wine
a mix of syrup and water
answer_texts: a mix of spirit and additive such as an aerated water

questions.question: What are three (3) basic questions you may need to ask when a customer orders a mixed drink?
options: Does the patron want to mix their own drink
Does the patron want long or short glass
Does the patron want ice or no ice
Does the patron want half or full measure
answer_texts: Does the patron want long or short glass
Does the patron want ice or no ice
Does the patron want half or full measure

questions.question: What is the standard procedure of making a mixed drink?
options: Add ice to glass, pour spirit, top up glass with additive, add garnish
Blend together ice, spirit, additive and garnish
Shake well ice, spirit, and carbonated water
answer_texts: Add ice to glass, pour spirit, top up glass with additive, add garnish

questions.question: A ‘shandy’ is …
options: beer with coke
beer with lemonade
beer with soda
answer_texts: beer with lemonade

questions.question: A ‘portergaff’ is …
options: stout with lemonade
beer with juice
beer with lime juice
answer_texts: stout with lemonade

questions.question: A ‘black and tan’ is …
options: beer and stout
beer with lemonade
beer with coke
answer_texts: beer and stout

questions.question: Identify five (5) different styles of beer.
options: Ale
Lager
Corona
Bitter
Guinness
Stout
Draught
answer_texts: Ale
Lager
Bitter
Stout
Draught

questions.question: A ‘mocktail’ is …
options: a non-alcoholic cocktail
an alcoholic cocktail
a lemon and lime drink
answer_texts: a non-alcoholic cocktail

questions.question: What is standard serve size for a nip of spirits?
options: 30ml
60ml
100ml
120ml
answer_texts: 30ml

questions.question: Identify the six (6) major spirits.
options: Brandy
Whisky
Wine
Gin
Tequila
Vodka
Rum
Beer
answer_texts: Brandy
Whisky
Gin
Tequila
Vodka
Rum

questions.question: What is ‘varietal’ wine made of?
options: A wine made from any variety of grapes
A wine made by aging in oak barrels
A wine made from grapes identified on the label
A wine made by aging in stainless steel barrels
answer_texts: A wine made from grapes identified on the label

questions.question: Identify five (5) practices for serving a bottle of wine to a guest.
options: Set appropriate glasses for type of wine
Present it announcing the name of the wine
Open it in front of guest
Leave it on table for guests to fill their glasses
Present the cork of red wine to the person ordering it
The main guest fills the glasses for the other guests
Leave white and sparkling wines in ice bucket
answer_texts: Set appropriate glasses for type of wine
Present it announcing the name of the wine
Open it in front of guest
Present the cork of red wine to the person ordering it
Leave white and sparkling wines in ice bucket

questions.question: What is meant by ‘cash service’ in a bar?
options: Customers go to the service counter, order their drink, and pay cash once the drink is served to them
Customers are served at the table and pay for their drink when leaving the bar
Customers go to the service counter, order their drink, and don’t pay cash as the drinks are covered by a beverage package
answer_texts: Customers go to the service counter, order their drink, and pay cash once the drink is served to them

questions.question: Which of the following apply to a ‘dry till’ in a bar? Select all that apply.
options: Used at events and private functions
Drinks are paid for once they are served at counter
Account is settled at the end of session
Drinks are served up to a set dollar limit
Drinks are served without a limit
answer_texts: Used at events and private functions
Account is settled at the end of session
Drinks are served up to a set dollar limit

questions.question: What is meant by an ‘inclusive package’ in terms of bar service? Select all that apply.
options: Price includes food and drinks
Price includes food, drinks, and room service
A limit is set on amount of liquor included according to RSA provisions
No set limit on amount of liquor included
answer_texts: Price includes food and drinks
A limit is set on amount of liquor included according to RSA provisions

questions.question: Which of the following apply to an ‘open bar’? Select all that apply.
options: Used for events and private parties
Guest can bring their own drinks to the bar
Guests can be served with whatever the bar has to offer
There are no restrictions on what guests can order
Guests can help themselves with any drink they like
answer_texts: Used for events and private parties
Guests can be served with whatever the bar has to offer
There are no restrictions on what guests can order

questions.question: Which of the following apply to ‘pre-set’ drinks? Select all that apply.
options: Used at functions, parties or set menus
Drinks arranged with the host in advance
Drinks that have been mixed before the event
Arranged amount and quantities to be provided at each table
Drinks that have been paid for in advance
answer_texts: Used at functions, parties or set menus
Drinks arranged with the host in advance
Arranged amount and quantities to be provided at each table

questions.question: Which of the following apply to ‘set limit’ for drinks in a bar? Select all that apply.
options: The maximum dollar value of drinks that can be served under a dry till situation
Guests are not eligible for any drinks beyond the set limit
Guests pay for their drinks over the limit
The drinks may be served only during a set time
answer_texts: The maximum dollar value of drinks that can be served under a dry till situation
Guests pay for their drinks over the limit

questions.question: What is the correct recipe for a ‘Bloody Mary’ cocktail?
options: 300ml vodka, dash fresh lemon juice, dash Worcestershire sauce, 2-3 drops of Tabasco sauce (to customer’s taste), salt, pepper, pinched of smoked paprika
30ml brandy, 30ml dark Créme de Cacao, 45ml cream
45ml vodka, 15ml Cointreau, 30ml cranberry juice, squeeze of fresh lime juice
answer_texts: 300ml vodka, dash fresh lemon juice, dash Worcestershire sauce, 2-3 drops of Tabasco sauce (to customer’s taste), salt, pepper, pinched of smoked paprika

questions.question: What is the correct preparation method for a ‘Brandy Alexander’ cocktail?
options: Build in glass and top with tomato juice
Shake in cocktail shaker with ice and strain into glass
Build in glass and stir with cocktail stirrer
answer_texts: Shake in cocktail shaker with ice and strain into glass

questions.question: What is the service requirement for a ‘Cosmopolitan’ cocktail?
options: Highball glass, garnish with celery stick, olives, lime slice
Champagne saucer, garnish with sprinkled/pinch of nutmeg
Martini or cocktail glass, garnish with lime slice or flamed orange zest
answer_texts: Martini or cocktail glass, garnish with lime slice or flamed orange zest

questions.question: What is the correct recipe for a ‘Daiquiri’ cocktail?
options: 30ml brandy, 30ml dark Créme de Cacao, 45ml cream
Equal quantities of white rum, Cointreau, and fresh lemon juice
45ml vodka, 15ml Cointreau, 30ml cranberry juice, squeeze of fresh lime juice
answer_texts: Equal quantities of white rum, Cointreau, and fresh lemon juice

questions.question: What is the service requirement for a ‘Grasshopper’ cocktail?
options: Highball glass, garnish with celery stick, olives, lime slice
Champagne saucer, garnish with 2 maraschino cherries, 2 straws and grated chocolate
Martini or cocktail glass, garnish with lime slice or flamed orange zest
answer_texts: Champagne saucer, garnish with 2 maraschino cherries, 2 straws and grated chocolate
